verdict.line: You lose if you eat her full E-Q1-Q2-W combo before level 6 without reacting; you win if you Death's Grasp her the instant she closes, or isolate her with Realm of Death at 6+.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser has the measured lane and solo-kill edge here, but the 49.7% win rate over 378 games shows that edge doesn't win itself — Camille's whole kit is one all-in burst window (E-hook, Q1 dash-auto, Q2 empowered auto, W true-damage cone) that punishes any Mordekaiser who doesn't immediately counter it. Whoever reacts to that window first controls the trade. Once R comes online at 6, the fight tilts hard toward you because it deletes her allies and her E-wall escape from the equation.

theirWindow.what: She gets the initiator's edge — Q1 dash-attack into Q2's second empowered auto, then W's cone slow with adaptive true damage — while you're forced to fight on her angle; a clean, uninterrupted combo does real damage by level 5, especially pre-6 before your R exists.

yourWindow.when: the moment her E lands or she commits
yourWindow.what: Immediately cast E (Death's Grasp) to pull her into and anchor her in melee before she can reset with Q2's hop or kite off with W's slow. This is the literal counter to her hit-and-run pattern — it turns her all-in into a stand-still fight where your P (Indestructible) shield and sustained damage take over.

powerCurve.note: Q trades fine, neither combo is online yet
her E-Q-W all-in unlocks before your R
Realm of Death isolates and removes her escape
Rylai's slow locks down her resets and hooks
her scaling and split-push close the gap

start.item: Doran's Ring, Health Potion, Health Potion
start.why: The dominant start at 49% WR over 337 games (72.5% pick) — the mana back gives you the sustain to throw Q (Obliterate) into every trade window instead of holding it for mana, which is what actually punishes her combo attempts.

boots.why: Top pick at 50.1% WR over 335 games (77.4% pick) — her damage in extended fights comes from repeated Q1/Q2 empowered autos and basic attacks, and flat auto mitigation directly cuts that source down.

core.why: The slow on Q and W is the single item that answers her kit — it clips her Q2 hop and denies the E-wall reset that defines her hit-and-run pattern.
Omnivamp plus the ramping true damage after 3 seconds in combat wins the extended fight once you've anchored her with E, and refuels your P (Indestructible) shield through sustained damage.
Burn damage that keeps ticking through her healing and armor stacking, especially strong once R has isolated her and removed her ability to just walk out of the DoT.

situational.when: she builds into heavy lifesteal or on-hit attack speed items
you need a hard-engage tool for skirmishes beyond your ult's single-target lock

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks up over the course of a prolonged trade and converts to adaptive force, which directly rewards the OP.GG-confirmed pattern of this matchup: winning the drawn-out fight after you've denied her burst-and-leave attempt.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite is the standard pick (79.9% pick rate) and matches your measured solo-kill advantage — it closes out all-ins after you've anchored her with E or isolated her with R. Flash + Teleport posts the higher win rate of the two (53.4% over 13.2% of games) if you'd rather play the patient, scaling route and use Teleport to reset waves after trades.

playing.title: Track her E cooldown
playing.detail: Hookshot has a long base cooldown; once she burns it without securing a kill, she has no dash-escape or wall-reset for several seconds — that's your cue to walk up and force a straight fight.

playing.title: E her the instant she jumps
playing.detail: The moment her Hookshot lands on you, cast Death's Grasp immediately. This is the exact counter OP.GG flags — it denies the Q2 hop-away and W kite that make up her hit-and-run pattern.

playing.title: Refresh Indestructible before it decays
playing.detail: Your passive shield falls off if you go too long without ability damage. Weave Q or E during her Q1-Q2 burst window so the shield is active when the damage actually lands, not decayed.

playing.title: Bait pre-6, punish at 6
playing.detail: Before level 6 her full combo out-damages your trade tools, so play for even trades, not kills. The moment R is up, look to isolate her — it strips her escape route and any ally peel.

playing.title: Slow her before she reaches a wall
playing.detail: Once Rylai's is online, every Q or W application slows her — force fights before she can reach wall-hook range instead of letting her disengage to set one up.

playing.title: Time Q for the trade, not the wave
playing.detail: Obliterate's stacks matter most in extended fights. Save at least one cast for the moment she commits her all-in rather than dumping it purely for clear.

playing.title: Hold Bone Plating's window in her all-in
playing.detail: Bone Plating blunts the first hits of her E-Q1-Q2-W sequence — stay at the edge of her engage range rather than backing off completely, so it's active when she commits.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, item paths, boots, rune pages, and summoner picks above are measured OP.GG data from real games on the current patch. The mechanical reasoning — cooldown tells, the E-counter timing, and the power-curve calls — is my own read of both kits, not part of the sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Do not let Camille hit and run by using [E] the moment she closes in. Maintain your [P] active to have the upper hand in prolonged fights.
